findings: DEFECT (filed, AMENDMENT-W1-15-01 §1): RI-STL01 §2 states V = clamp(L^0.7 ...) and publishes five worked rows that L^0.7 cannot produce. Rows 2 and 3 are 2.0x wrong; row 4 is annotated '(clamped)' and at gamma 0.7 its raw value 0.0733 never reaches the 0.05 floor. gamma = 1.36 reproduces all five within 0.5%. Shipped as DATA (detection.json visibility.light_exponent) with the arithmetic and a how_to_disagree field.

DEFECT (filed, §2): RI-CRM02 §8 asserts max 2 simultaneous sanctioning authorities; §4's exclusivity table permits three (Warrant + Ledger + ku-vastei). Found by exhaustive search over the join graph, not by reading. Closed with one further exclusion whose in-fiction reason falls out of the two institutions' own products.

DEFECT (filed, §3): RI-STL02 §6 declares fenceGreed in [0.85, 1.10] while method 9 asserts a best multiplier in [0.58, 0.62]; 0.35 x 1.71 x 1.10 = 0.658 is outside it. Shipped roster tops at greed 1.02.

S21 APPLIED, NOT AMENDED: RI-STL02 §5 says pickpocketing has no roll; ARBITRATION §2 S21 (intent audit 02, ND-01) says it keeps one and names RI-STL02 as the item to reconcile. ARBITRATION §5 rung 2 > rung 3, so the die is built — geometry stays deterministic, exactly one draw on the completion frame.

CALIBRATION TRAP AVOIDED: the first pickpocket notice formula used a subtractive Sneak term and collapsed to its 2% floor by Sneak 45 — it passes every assertion and makes S21 decorative. The shipped multiplicative form stays live from 4.1% to 85%.

NOT MINE, FLAGGED: W1-14 bound `spell_cycle` to KeyR, which is already `heavy`'s primary binding. buildControlMap() is last-write-wins, so the heavy attack currently has no keyboard binding on the desktop path. auditBindings() does not check duplicate controls, which is why it still returns [].

TOOLING: a live Playwright page.evaluate that reseeded the engine and replayed the ward-collar 8-40 times in one call hung the bridge reproducibly and I could not diagnose it in budget. The 100-seed determinism sweep runs headless in stl-probe.mjs instead; the live probe proves the wiring. Stated in the source and the report rather than hidden.

W1-07's hostile_below_disposition in character/encounter.js is the AR-3 hook — do not build a parallel one. W1-09's backstab in combat/resolve.js is the opener target — routing to it is what keeps OPENER-PURITY true.
